description: CURRENT_ACCOUNT() - live-tolerant: every value cell compares against the session's own answer, since a real run rides whatever account it connects to, and the fixtures are built server-side with INSERT ... SELECT CURRENT_ACCOUNT() rather than by interpolating the name. Covers the answer being non-empty, use in a WHERE clause, under an alias, in a join, repeated in one projection, called in any letter case, and inside a grouped aggregate. The engine's configured default (ABC12345) is pinned in its own embedded-only test. Converted from functions/CurrentAccountTest, which is trimmed to the three tests that build a throwaway DatabaseEngine with a custom account id - a bootstrap property with no SQL surface.

steps.sql: SELECT CURRENT_ACCOUNT() IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(CURRENT_ACCOUNT()) > 0

skip.reason: the engine's configured default account id is an embedded-engine fact; a live run rides whatever account it connects to

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE accounts (id INTEGER, account_id VARCHAR)
SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE account_id = CURRENT_ACCOUNT()
SELECT account_identifier = CURRENT_ACCOUNT() FROM (SELECT CURRENT_ACCOUNT() AS account_identifier)
CREATE TABLE user_accounts (user_id INTEGER, account_id VARCHAR)
CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)

SELECT u.name
FROM users u
JOIN user_accounts ua ON u.id = ua.user_id
WHERE ua.account_id = CURRENT_ACCOUNT()
SELECT a = CURRENT_ACCOUNT(), b = CURRENT_ACCOUNT(), c = CURRENT_ACCOUNT() FROM (SELECT CURRENT_ACCOUNT() AS a, CURRENT_ACCOUNT() AS b, CURRENT_ACCOUNT() AS c)
CREATE TABLE transactions (id INTEGER, account_id VARCHAR, amount DECIMAL(10,2))

SELECT '<' || SUM(amount) || '>' AS total
FROM transactions
WHERE account_id = CURRENT_ACCOUNT()
GROUP BY account_id
